# Shruti 1.4.22 — beta polish
- Shruti now opens on a Mac with no internet connection the first time, not only after it has been online once: the app inside the installer carries its own Apple approval. - App names in the mixer are no longer cut short by the LIVE label; a small green waveform shows an app is making sound. - The output device name is shown in full ("Zen Studio Playback", "MacBook Pro Speakers"). - Audio Devices opens on the device that is playing now. - The Bypass All shortcut is written as Shift-Command-Esc in Settings.
Stress-tested on the studio Mac mini before release: about 1,000 rapid volume, mute, Bypass All and Scene changes (including four at once) with zero failures; a 10-minute endurance run; a force-killed audio helper came back in 1 second and a force-killed audio service in 1 second, with no leftover processes. 781 automated checks pass.
